snippet.title: Re: Rite - Official Reveal Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Re: Rite, a post-utopian brawler developed by Buffalo Buffalo. Players will explore a world where human consciousnesses (“seeds”) grow into living, plant-based robotic bodies (“shells”) to face off in combat. Re: Rite is coming soon to PC (Steam).
